name: t3_thread_list
title: List T3 threads
description: List threads newest first, in one project or with `allProjects`. Page with `cursor`.

name: t3_thread_read
title: Read a T3 thread
description: Read any thread by id. `messages` (default): user and assistant messages and plans. `activity`: all timeline items. Keep reads small: low `limit` and `maxCharsPerItem`. Page with `afterPosition=nextPosition`. Cut-off text: `itemId` with `textOffset=nextTextOffset`. Reading a child's final result marks it delivered. In your reply, name it as its `link` verbatim.

name: t3_thread_send
title: Send to a T3 thread
description: Send a message to any thread. The target cannot run with broader modes than yours. `mode:'auto'` starts an idle thread, steers a running turn, or queues. `queue`: new turn. `steer`: mid-turn update. `restart`: interrupt and restart. A send to a finished child thread starts a fresh task and returns its `taskId`. In your reply, name it as its `link` verbatim.

name: t3_thread_wait
title: Wait for a T3 thread
description: Wait for a thread's run to finish. No `runId`: latest. Idle: at once. On timeout, with `next` end your turn; without, call again.

untilDelegatedWorkSettled.description: Also wait for its delegated and background tasks and their completions to settle. `resultRun` then names the run with its final answer.

enum: Completion wakes this thread, so end your turn. Do not wait on it or poll it.

name: t3_pending_request
description: Pending user questions in a thread. Omit `threadId` for this thread. list: their ids; approvals are not listed. read: one by `requestId`. respond: answer one with `answers`; this cannot approve a permission request.

name: t3_thread_launch
description: Create one new top-level thread, bound to its workspace before the agent starts. Task in `message`. Omit `projectId`, model and modes to inherit yours (outside a thread, pass `projectId` or `scratch`); modes cannot exceed yours. After an error or lost reply, retry with the same `clientRequestId`. Follow it with `t3_thread_read` or `t3_thread_wait`. Mention it with its `link`.

scratch.description: No project: a new Scratch folder. Not with `projectId` or `workspaceStrategy`.

workspaceStrategy.description: 'worktree': new checkout from `baseRef`. 'existing_worktree': bind `worktreePath`, a project worktree. 'root': project checkout, the default, not your worktree. Stack: parent branch as `baseRef`, `startFromOrigin: false`. Uncommitted edits are not copied.

message.description: First prompt. Omit it and `attachments` for idle.
